verdict: Palantir's revenue grew 85% to $1.63B as U.S. commercial revenue more than doubled, and net income reached $876M — an extraordinary 54% of revenue.

segments.name: Government
segments.note: Software for the U.S. military, intelligence agencies and allied governments — U.S. government revenue alone grew 84% to $687M.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.note: Software for companies — U.S. commercial revenue jumped 133% to $595M as businesses raced to put AI to work, and Palantir closed $1.18B of U.S. commercial contract value in the quarter.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Sales teams and the 'bootcamp' try-before-you-buy push that has been winning commercial customers.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the platforms — Gotham, Foundry and the AIP AI layer.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company: legal, finance and offices.

takeaways.title: U.S. commercial is exploding
takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue more than doubled to $595M, and the pipeline points the same way: U.S. commercial remaining deal value hit $4.92B, up 112% YoY.

takeaways.title: A 46% operating margin
takeaways.text: GAAP operating income was $754M — 46 cents of every revenue dollar — because revenue grew 85% while running costs grew far more slowly.

takeaways.title: Record deal value closed
takeaways.text: Palantir closed $2.41B of total contract value in the quarter, up 61% YoY, including 206 deals of at least $1M.

oneTimers: Stock-based compensation of $202M sits inside cost of revenue and operating expenses; excluding it and related employer payroll taxes, adjusted operating income was $984M (a 60% margin) instead of $754M.
otherDetail: Interest income of $66M on Palantir's cash pile plus $68M of other income — $134M added below operating profit (rounded from the release's thousands).
footerNote: Net income here is Palantir's total net income of $876M; $871M of it is attributable to common stockholders (the rest belongs to noncontrolling interests). Segment figures come from Palantir's Q1 2026 10-Q, rounded to the nearest $M.
